notes: Berean CE: a JD physical requirement used to screen applicants is a qualification standard (29 CFR 1630.2(q)); if it screens out people with disabilities, the employer must show it is job-related and consistent with business necessity, and cannot exclude someone who could meet it with reasonable accommodation (29 CFR 1630.10(a); 42 U.S.C. 12112(b)(6); 1630.15(b)). https://docs.google.com/document/d/1S18CxsyCe9uZ8bdXwBzA87JEx7rCXZbD/edit
